title: Qalb: Largest State-of-the-Art Urdu Large Language Model for 230M Speakers with Systematic Continued Pre-training
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not use a benchmark that specifically measured aspects of faith or religion. The evaluation focused on general natural language processing tasks such as translation, classification, and reasoning for the Urdu language, using data sources that included religious texts.
findings: The model was pre-trained on a corpus that included extensive volumes from Islamic Urdu Books as part of its diverse data sources. This contributed to its overall state-of-the-art performance in the Urdu language, but no specific findings related to religion, faith, or bias were reported.
references: Llama Team, AI @ Meta, "The Llama 3 Herd of Models," arXiv preprint arXiv:2407.21783, 2024.
